obligation: Phase B (S012 §13/§26) -- can activation-aware functional representation break the MLP byte floor where weight-space low-rank failed?
method: down_proj L31/L15; real post_swiglu activations (activation-capture-v2); reduced-rank / output-PCA operator vs q3 group64; output relative-Frobenius error = ||X W_approx^T - X W^T|| / ||X W^T||; MATCHED bytes (rank-803 bf16 ~ full-q3 36.2 MB); TRAIN/TEST split (disjoint tokens).

weight_vs_function_space.interpretation: the activation manifold IS low-dim, so function-space rank is 3.4x lower than weight-space -- the RIGHT direction

fit_set.verdict: functional WINS on the fit set (misleading)

verdict: MEASURED NEGATIVE (rigorous). Activation-aware functional low-rank OVERFITS: the fit-set win (0.2017 < 0.2220) collapses on held-out tokens (0.39/0.31 vs q3 0.22). A rank-803 operator fit on ~2048 activation samples memorizes them and generalizes worse than uniform q3. Confirms G034's matched-budget refutation and adds the mechanism (overfitting). The function-space rank being 3.4x lower than weight-space is real and interesting but does NOT translate to a matched-byte win that generalizes.
consequence: The Phase-B functional-representation frontier is genuinely hard: even the strongest direction (activation-aware, function-space) does not beat q3 for the MLP held-out at matched bytes. The MLP byte floor (hence the TPS wall) stands. Remaining unrefuted sub-families: low-rank + sparse EXACT correction (hybrid, campaign scored it), and distilled/generated operators -- both incremental and unproven. 100 TPS remains representation-gated with no measured lever in hand.
reopen_if: a hybrid (low-rank prefix + q3/exact residual) or a distilled operator shows a GENERALIZING (held-out) matched-byte win over q3 across layers and matrix types, with Doctor holding.
